newsitem.title: USA: Prudential names Fishera to head capital finance.
newsitem.headline: Prudential names Fishera to head capital finance.

text.p: Prudential Securities said Monday it named Joseph Fishera managing director of its capital finance group.
The company said Fishera, who rejoins the firm eight years after he departed as a director in 1989, will also serve as the group's head of business origination and development.

Fishera recently completed an 18-month sabbatical during which he served as an executive fellow at the Woodrow Wilson School of Public and International Affairs at Princeton University, Prudential said.
Prior to the sabbatical, Fishera was a managing director at Bear Stearns Cos Inc, Prudential said.
Prudential said Fishera brings to 11 the number of bankers and senior equity analysts it has hired in the last two months.
